construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
Matched on street and unit count (85); source address 7201; state report 7245.

City of San Jose permit PD21-015 (Planned Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2021), status Inactive: "Planned Development Permit to allow demolition of an existing residential building and the removal of 26 trees (10 ordinance-size, 16 non-ordinance-size) for construction of a seven-story, 85-unit, multi-family residential building on an approximately 0.9" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

Earlier city preliminary reviews on the same APN: PRE13-170 (85-unit, 6-story condominium, 2013), PRE15-214 (82 units on 6 stories, applicant Jason Lee / CRE Investment Fund, 2015), PRE16-153 (6-story, 85-unit residential building, 2016). PRE14-129 (Ko Architects, 2014) covered a larger 1.8-acre, 141-unit mixed-use site including this parcel.

City permit layer description for ER21-141 and PD21-015: demolition of an existing residential building, removal of 26 trees (10 ordinance-size, 16 non-ordinance-size), seven-story multifamily building with up to 85 units. SF YIMBY reports 32 trees and a 192-space two-level below-grade garage.
